reproductions_before_fix.ctx_create_pointer: pre-fix library: bal_cuda_ctx_create(2^25, 4096) returned -5 but left the caller output pointer at its sentinel 0x1234 (size caps were checked before *out_ctx was written)
reproductions_before_fix.legacy_abi: bal_cuda_batch checked only count and threads; header/target_le/hashes/flags went straight to cudaMemcpy; count*32 allocation size unchecked (count 0xFFFFFFFF would request 128 GiB and rely on the allocator)
reproductions_before_fix.python_api: CudaContext.search_complete had no validation of its own before set_work/backend calls
reproductions_before_fix.accounting: forced-overflow stats had no candidate_count, no overflow_splits and no initial/recovery time split (measured in the before example)
reproductions_before_fix.batch_verification: batch_search counted and recorded failed C/CUDA candidates but still trusted and returned the remaining pairs; the range was not independently re-covered; the generic enumeration path silently dropped target-meeting digests that failed verification

corrections.detail: shared bal_cuda_batch_validate runs before any dereference, copy or CUDA call: null header/target_le/hashes/flags -1; zero count or threads outside [1,1024] -1; subtraction-based range failure -4; count over BAL_CUDA_LEGACY_MAX_BATCH (2^24) -6; allocation sizes via bal_checked_mul_size, overflow -5; validator sizes used for allocation and copies; single cleanup path attempts every free and reports a free error when the batch itself succeeded; ctx_search validates candidate buffers before any CUDA operation; ctx_batch_diag validates header/target explicitly; ctx_create uses checked multiplication for all count-derived sizes
corrections.tests: host_checks legacy_abi_validate 14 of 14; compiled-library ctypes: null header/target/hashes/flags -1, threads 0 and 1025 -1, count 0 -1, range crossing -4, count 2^24+1 -6, count 0xFFFFFFFF -6, valid arguments reach the runtime (35 on this GPU-less VM)

corrections.detail: *out_ctx is set to nullptr immediately after the out_ctx null check, before all other validation and allocation; every failure path leaves it null; success writes it exactly once
corrections.tests: compiled library: sentinel 0x1234 becomes null for max_count 2^25 (-5), cand_cap 2^23 (-5), max_count 0 (-1), and for valid arguments failing in the CUDA runtime (35); null out_ctx returns -1

corrections.detail: validate_header (bytes-like, exactly 80), validate_target (int in [0,2^256) or exactly 32 little-endian bytes), validate_nonce_range (subtraction-based), validate_threads ([1,1024]); applied in CudaContext.search_complete before any backend call, and in search, batch_diag, set_work and the constructor (max_count in [1,2^24]); search_complete passes max_chunk=self._max_count to the recovery driver
corrections.tests: 29 invalid inputs plus a crossing range each rejected with zero backend calls (counting stubs); valid boundaries accepted: start 0, final nonce alone, whole space ending exactly at 2^32, targets as bytes and bytearray; CudaContext.search rejects bad inputs with zero native calls; constructor rejects bad max_count

corrections.detail: five fields threaded through collect_candidates_complete, CudaContext.search/search_complete and ComputeEngine.batch_search: unique_coverage, device_hashes, researched_hashes, overflow_splits, candidate_count (overflow_events kept as alias); invariant device_hashes == unique_coverage + researched_hashes asserted; split depth cap MAX_OVERFLOW_SPLIT_DEPTH 32; driver validates returned candidates and records initial_search_seconds, recovery_search_seconds, search_seconds, kernel_ms_total; CUDA-path hashrate is device_hashes per second, coverage_per_second separate; CPU last_search_stats naming mapped in documentation without renames
corrections.tests: exact capacity, one over capacity, forced multi-split overflow (220 splits), 65536 range, max_chunk capping, always-overflowing backend raises explicitly; batch stats checked on C, CUDA and fallback paths

corrections.detail: _check_pairs requires in-range, unique, CPU-verified pairs; any failure poisons the enumeration; _rescan_all_candidates discards the backend pairs and independently re-covers the whole range with the trusted Python implementation, recording the event and accounting; generic enumeration path counts failures, recovers legacy CUDA digests by rescan, and raises an explicit error for CPU-fallback failures; coverage_status states the outcome on every batch path
corrections.tests: corrupt C candidate, out-of-range C candidate and corrupt CUDA candidate each recovered to the exact recounted set with exact accounting and GPU device_hashes preserved; CPU-fallback verification failure raises an explicit RuntimeError
